content:
Let \(N\) be the number of tea bags in a box.

For \(N\) tea bags, the total cups of tea can be any integer from \(2N\) to \(3N\), because each bag contributes either 2 or 3 cups.

So:
\[
2N \le 41 \le 3N \implies 14 \le N \le 20
\]
and
\[
2N \le 58 \le 3N \implies 20 \le N \le 29
\]

The only integer satisfying both is
\[
N=20
\]

\[
\boxed{20}
\]
